answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted peer grading with delayed vesting. Fresh identities start with a thin yarrow of trust: they can answer, but their grades barely move rewards until peers attest their work across several epochs. That multi-epoch trail becomes the anchor. High-value attestation rights stay tied to an onyx-hard reputation score that only accrues when independent graders agree, so spinning up throwaway agents is expensive and slow to pay off.
